questions.question: What was India’s fiscal deficit in 2024–25 as a percentage of GDP?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**4.8%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Govt. meets 4.8% fiscal deficit target for 2024-25.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Fiscal Deficit** for FY **2024–25** stood at **₹15.77 lakh crore**, **4.8% of GDP**, meeting the government's target.

 
 
• 
 
Total **revenue**: **₹30.78 lakh crore**.

 
 
• 
 
**Net tax revenue**: **₹24.99 lakh crore** (97.7% of target).

 
 
• 
 
**Disinvestment earnings**: **₹10,131 crore**, significantly **below target**.

 
 
• 
 
Total **expenditure**: **₹46.55 lakh crore** (97.8% of revised estimate).

 
 
• 
 
**Capital expenditure**: **₹10.52 lakh crore** (long-term investments).

 
 
• 
 
**Revenue expenditure**: **₹36.03 lakh crore**.

 
 
• 
 
**Fiscal Deficit** formula:
 **Fiscal Deficit = Total Expenditure – (Revenue Receipts + Non-Debt Creating Capital Receipts)**

questions.question: What is the name of the operation launched to secure the Amarnath Yatra 2025?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Operation Shiva**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Indian Army launches ‘Operation Shiva’ to ensure foolproof security for Amarnath Yatra 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The Army launched **Operation Shiva** to ensure **foolproof security** for the **Amarnath Yatra.**

 
 
• 
 
The shrine is located at **3,888 meters** in **Jammu & Kashmir**.

 
 
• 
 
Over **42,000 security personnel** deployed, including **CRPF, BSF, SSB, ITBP**, and **CISF**.

 
 
• 
 
Two main pilgrimage routes: **Pahalgam** and **Baltal**.

 
 
• 
 
Security includes **drone surveillance**, **CCTV monitoring**, **bulletproof vehicles**, and **route clearance**.

 
 
• 
 
Includes **anti-sabotage checks** and **three-tier security setup**.

 
 
• 
 
Enhanced **medical**, **transport**, and **accommodation** facilities from **Lakhanpur** onward.

 
 
• 
 
**RFID cards** made mandatory for all pilgrims for **tracking and safety**.

questions.question: Recently the Mount Etna erupted and was in the news. Where is it located?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Italy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Mount Etna erupts: All about Europe’s most active volcano.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Mount Etna** in **Sicily, Italy** erupted on **June 2, 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
The eruption produced a **cloud of smoke and ash** rising several kilometres into the air.

 
 
• 
 
Mount Etna is a **UNESCO World Heritage Site**.

 
 
• 
 
It is one of **Europe’s and the world’s most active volcanoes**.

 
 
• 
 
Documented eruption activity spans over **2,700 years**, making it one of the **longest historic volcanic records** in the world.

questions.question: Bihar begins vegetable exports to ___________ via VEGFED cooperative.
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Dubai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Bihar begins vegetable exports to Dubai via VEGFED cooperative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
Bihar begins **vegetable exports** through **VEGFED**, modeled on dairy cooperative **COMFED**.

 
 
• 
 
**First consignment** of **1500 kg** sent to **Dubai** via **Varanasi**.

 
 
• 
 
**Cooperative Minister Prem Kumar** flagged it off for **LuLu Mall, Dubai**.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the next chief of R&AW? (June 2025)
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Parag Jain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Pakistan expert Parag Jain appointed as new RAW Chief, succeeds Ravi Sinha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

 
• 
 
The **central government** has appointed **Parag Jain** as the next **chief of R&AW** (Research and Analysis Wing).

 
 
• 
 
**Parag Jain** is a **1989-batch IPS officer** from the **Punjab cadre**.

 
 
• 
 
He will succeed **Ravi Sinha**, the current **R&AW chief**, whose **tenure ends on June 30, 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
Jain’s **appointment is for a fixed two-year term**.

 
 
• 
 
He will **assume office on July 1, 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
Currently, **Parag Jain** is the **second senior-most official** in **R&AW**, after **Ravi Sinha**.
